content: Saule naku pumena olufu lwa Setefani. Saule yo yandisa Ekeleke Cwale ba liywaa elyo sebeli kwinguka okuyandisiwa kunene mu Ndoo ya Nyambe mu Jelusalema, mi onje kame anakuhasanela mu naha no Judeya ni Samaliya sebeli kusiyala fela Atumiwa omboci.
Alume anjili no aasikupumena sebeli ata oka pumbeka Setefani, niku mulila onene.
Kono Saule sebeli otateka okusisinya Endoo ya Nyambe, ni kwingena mu tindoo okukokamo alume na kati ni kwaaingenyeka mu tolongo.
Eliywi no Kuwaba sebeli likutaziwa mu Samaliya
Cwale awo anaku hasanyiwa sebeli ata alemine okukutaza eliywi.
Filipi sebeli ota mu mulenen̄i no Samaliya, nukaamba eyi ya Kilesite kwa onyene.
Aanu nokupula sebeli aikala ni mucima mumweya okutambula eyo anakwamba Filipi, Cwale sebeli amuyupa nikumona etimakazo ana kutende.
Kakuli Emebo no kwiiba sebeli inakutunda mwaanu nokupula awo anakwingeniwa yolemine okukuwa ni liywi linene, naanu asikukutela olun̄an̄ali ni iyanga no makondo sebeli abalisiwa.
Cwale okuwabelelwa noku neneba sebeli kwikalamo omo mu mulenen̄i.
Simoni onganga
Kono oweli kame kunakwikala omulume onakwisaniwa Simoni onakutendanga amabibo mu tolopo no Samaliya onaku komokisanga esicaba, yonyene kame ana kukyemanga nji munu nokuneneba,
mi onje kame anaku mukutekanga, okutangisa ku mwanukana okutwala ku mukulu, sebeli aamba nji, “Uyu mulume ni maata a Nyambe awo aisanwa nji, ‘Amaata no kuneneba.’”
Kame anaku mukolwa kakuli naku tangisa kale okwakomokisa ni mabibo aye.
Kono aba anaku pumena Filipi aba anakwaambela eliywi no kuwaba no muboso wa Nyambe ni litina lya Jesu Kilesite onje alume nakati sebeli akolobeziwa.
Simba yonyene Simoni naku pumena, mi munyima no ku kolobeziwa sebeli okumalela Filipi, mi aba mona etimakazo neyi ikomokisa, sebeli okomoka.
Cwale atumiwa ku Jelusalema abaana kuyupa nji amasamaliya kame anatambula eliywi lya Nyambe, sebeli atuma Pitolosi ni Jowani.
Awo abaana kukeela sebeli aalapelela nji abiwe Emebo No Kukena.
Kakuli Emebo No Kukena kaya siku shulumukela simba ku mumweya kwa onyene, kono kame anaku kolobeziwa fela mu litina lya Mbumu Jesu.
Cewale sebeli abeka amaoko oo beulu yoo mi sbeli atambula Emebo No Kukena.
Cwale Simoni aba aaku mona nji Emebo kame inabiwi mukubeka amaoko no atumiwa, sebeli waasepisa okwaba amali,
ni kwamba nji, “Munibe ku maata awo, nji omunu yonje sanibeeke amaoko mba tambula Emebo No Kukenaa.”
Kono Pitolosi sebeli omwambela nji, “Amali owe ofe nawo, kakuli kame onahana nji kame ofanena okula empo ya Nyambe ni mali!
Kakwisa esi sobiwe simba esemba, mu taba eyo, kakuli omucima wowe kausiluka mu miyo a Nyambe.
Obake mu uyi wowe, mi olapele Nyambe, mwendi mbufanene okulemenwa omuhupulo oli mu mucima wowe.
Kakuli kame ni mona nji kame oli mu mioti no kulula onene ni mu tolongo no sibi.”
Simoni sebeli otambula nji, “Muni lapelele kwa Nyambe, nji kakwisa esinjili kweyo mu naamba sasini kwele.”
Cwale aba anakumana okupaka eliywi lya Nyambe, sebeli aukela ku Jelusalema, okakutaza eliywi no kuwaba kwaanu no kupula no masamaya.
Filipi ni Nduna no Muisopiya
Kono elin̄eloi lya Mbumu sebeli lyambela Filipi nji, “Oimane mi ote ku Mbowela, ku ndila ishetumuka ku Jelusalema okuta ku Gaza, no lihalaupa, eyo nokwa endiwangwa.”

Cwale sebeli oimana ni kutako, sebeli omona omulume no muisopiya, neli muumba, esikombwa sinene sa Kandasi, Ombumu no mukati no isopiya, neli omubabaleli no ufumu waye onje, neyi mu Jelusalema muku lapela
mi muku ukela kwaawo yoikalile mu koloi yaye yo lemine okubala mu buka no munuhi Isaya
Emebo No Kukena sebeli yamba kwa Filipi nji, “Otwalelelele, oshetete ku koloi eyi.”
Cwale Filipi sebeli oitukela kwa yonyene, niku muyupa yobala mu buka no munuhi Isaya, ni kumwibanguta nji, “Kame uyupa eyo olemine okubala?”
Onduna sebeli otambula nji, “Ngasibine sani yupisise, okuulwile omunu onisimweta?” mi sebeli omema Filipi okutina nji aikale naye.
Cwale ekalulo no lin̄olo anaku bala neli eyi,

content.text: simba akana no mukoko nokwalila owoya wako aba upatuliwa,
Mu kwenisiwa, mi ekatulo yaye sebeli iimekiwa.
kakuli omoyo waye nautundisiwa mu litunga.”

content: Cwale onduna sebeli oibanguta Filipi nji, “Onambele, kame ni kulapela, omunuhi aba aamba eyi, kame akwamba yonyene nji kame aamba omunjili?”
Cwale Filipi sebeli oyamisa akanwa kaye ni kutangisa nelyo elin̄olo okumwambela amaywi no kuwaba a Jesu.
Cwale alemine okuta mu ndila sebeli awana abakuli ameyi, mi onduna sebeliwamba nji, “Omone, bano kame kuli ameyi. sikene esi sasini kanise oku kolobeziwa?”
Filipi sebeli wamba nji, “Nji kame opumena ni mucima wowe wonje, kame kukonahala. Nduna sebeli otambula nji, Kame ni pumena nji Jesu Kilesite ni Mwanaa Nyambe.”
Onduna sebeli olaelela ekoloi okwimana, onje Filipi ni Nduna sebeli aingena mu meyi, mi Filipi sebeli kolobeza onduna.
Cwale aba anakutunda mu meyi, Emebo ya Nyambe sebeli ishimba Filipi, mi onduna nakuulwa okumona Filipi kame, cwale sebeli otwalelela mu mwendo waye yo wabelelwe.
Kono Filipi nokakuwana mu Azoto, yo twalelela okukutaza eliywi no kuwaba mu titolopo tonje mane sebeli okakeela ku Sizeliya.
